audit.argument: An armed turn near a scheduled catalyst fires the session BEFORE the event when a continuous weather ramp is live, and waits for the event when it is not. The causal argument is genuine and stated - weather models are a continuous twice-daily information stream, so when live they own the timing and the discrete print only adds magnitude and liquidity. But the core support is a catalogue: '1110 exhausted -> 1111 +1580', '1118 armed -> 1119 +1930', '1203 front-run confirmed +1520', with the fired/waited arm assigned after the fact. There is no independent measurement anywhere in the corpus of the ramp-live condition against a front-run rate. This is the best-behaved OUTCOME_CREDITED play in the batch - it carries two live self-falsifications (G9 1204 forward-failed in its original form and was re-armed; G10 0108 established the forbidden polarity-flip form) - but its support is still a list of days that delivered.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Partly, and the part that could is the good part. The G16 pair is a real discriminator test that traces exactly to the committed price file: 0401 (D-1 to a pre-priced +34 print) delivered -590 and 0402 round-tripped to -150 / day_move -130, against 0409 (not pre-priced, building surplus on the block's most active tape) which delivered -610 with NO round-trip. Had 0409 also round-tripped, the discriminator would have died on the spot. That is real. The core fired-vs-waited tally (n=3 fired, n=2 waited) is not - it is five days sorted into two bins after the outcome.

plays.trigger: at the close of a swing-side day on an extended run (ARM), then at the close of the first counter day (CONFIRM)
plays.read: run length + amplitude vs the season's prior largest swing + the extension day's close-vs-extreme; then the counter day's net vs its condition-class band + old-direction continuation-collapse; a weekend gap AGAINST the crest counts as the counter
plays.call: ARM when the swing is PARABOLIC (>=~1.5-2x the season's prior largest swing amplitude, >=~9 sessions, no origin-shelf touch) AND the extension day closes >=~30% off its intraday extreme (blow-off / late-tape roll-over). CONFIRM (S99.2 HARDENED - ALL conditions): (C1) BAND-BREAK: the first counter day's net breaks its condition-class counter band by >=~1.5x (an in-band bounce, however strong-looking, is NOT a confirm); (C2) OLD-SIDE CONTINUATION-COLLAPSE verified in that day's ACTUAL tape: old-direction legs continuing <=~15% overall AND old-side big legs (>=$300) not majority-alive (<=~1/3 or absent); (C3) PRINTED, NEVER FRONT-RUN: polarity flips only AFTER the confirm day closes - catalyst_continuity_frontrun applies to WITH-chain resumes only, never to a flip; (C4) in the waited/no-band-break form the next scheduled print is the ARBITER: counter-side delivery confirms the turn (0925, 1030), chain-side delivery refutes it (0109). A weekend gap AGAINST the crest still counts as the counter delivery (1207). TERMINATION vs BIRTH: a passing signature always ENDS the old chain (no fundamental agreement needed - 1208 flipped against a bullish backdrop), but a sustained counter-CHAIN births only with a forward fundamental driver; if the weekly fundamental stream is actively RE-CONFIRMING the old chain (surplus re-widening under a down-chain), the outcome is TERMINATION-TO-BASING/BLEED (structure.post_parabolic_bleed), not a new chain. After a true CONFIRM: every polarity-relative rule reads in the NEW direction and R5's origin shelf is VOID. Without the parabolic arm, an armed crest is only a GIVE-BACK (G7) - do not flip. || S100.2 PER-INSTANCE REFINEMENT: C1 (band-break) is the load-bearing condition and is sufficient on its own across every instance tested. || S100.3 C2 MEASURED (comparable base, see meta.s100_3_c2_measured_note + C2_RATIO_FINDINGS_S98.md): the ratio reformulation is REFUTED - 0120 (true) 0.714 vs 0107 (false) 0.718, near-identical on every C2 arm. C2 is KEPT and SCOPED: it discriminates on its four 2025 instances (collapse to <=10% old-side continuation) and is NON-DISCRIMINATING on the 0107/0120 tape class, where it ABSTAINS and the confirm completes as C1 + C3 + C4. Score all arms on every future instance regardless.
plays.requires: needs_day_N-1_tape - C1 and C4 are both measurable at the confirm day's CLOSE, so the flip IS callable at the next session's open. C2's tape read is also a day-N-1 measurement. NOTHING in the rule requires an intraday reveal; the rule is open-time applicable to the session AFTER the confirm.
plays.scope: block lean / polarity - the input every other polarity-relative play consumes. It owns no day net directly.
plays.caveats: PER-INSTANCE, never pooled. The rule is KEPT and is used on the instances its conditions discriminate on. C1 carries it everywhere tested. plays.falsifier: A counter day whose net breaks its condition-class band by >=1.5x, evaluated at the close and not front-run, that is NOT followed by a sustained polarity change - a genuine C1 false positive. Six fires and zero false positives is a real record and the falsifier is well formed. It has had no opportunity to discharge since G14 because in the blind the condition cannot be evaluated at all. TWO THINGS WOULD SETTLE IT, both cheap: serve the prior day's realized net (or the condition-class band table) in the blind state, and re-derive the bands for the modern amplitude regime, where the historical 1,800-5,010 fires sit at or above the corpus maximum day move of 2,100.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: EVERY ARM'S OPERAND IS UNSERVED, INCLUDING THE REFERENCE THE BAR IS MEASURED AGAINST. The ARM needs swing amplitude as a ratio to 'the season's prior largest swing' (>=~1.5-2x), run length in sessions (>=~9) and a close >=~30% off the intraday extreme. The CONFIRM needs C1 (the counter day's net breaking its condition-class counter band by >=~1.5x), C2 (old-direction leg continuation <=~15%, big legs <=~1/3 alive), C3 (a pure sequencing rule - 'printed, never front-run' - which carries no bar at all) and C4 (the direction the next scheduled print delivers). None of swing amplitude, run length, close-off-extreme, leg-continuation rate or arbiter-print direction is in the vocabulary. C1 is the sharpest case and it fails twice: its operand (the prior day's realized net) is price content frozen under the mask, and its REFERENCE - the condition-class counter-band table - is, in the play's own health field, 'not served as a numeric table anywhere - each specialist re-derives them', so there is no value to compare against and any absolute dollar figure I wrote would be invented. The health field's verdict is unambiguous: under the mask C1 is 'permanently UNKNOWN - never true, never false'. That is exactly the state a curated condition must never be allowed to fake.

audit.argument: Claim: a chain polarity flip needs an ARM (parabolic run >=~1.5-2x the prior largest swing, >=~9 sessions, plus a >=30%-off blow-off close) and a four-condition CONFIRM (C1 band-break >=1.5x, C2 old-side continuation-collapse, C3 printed-never-front-run, C4 catalyst arbiter). This is the best-supported play in the batch and the support is falsification-shaped, not narrative. The per-instance table carries counts that could have gone the other way: C1 fires 1008 / 1020 / 1208 / 1223 / 0120 / 0302 and correctly DECLINES 0107 - six fires, one correct decline, zero false positives across G4/G5/G9/G10/G11/G14. It carries a documented FALSE POSITIVE (G10 0108) and a documented FALSE NEGATIVE (G11 0120) on opposite sides of the same bar, and says so in its own text. C2's ratio reformulation was REFUTED on comparable data (0120 true 0.714 vs 0107 false 0.718, near-identical on every arm) and was KEPT-AND-SCOPED rather than quietly dropped. (B4) prints stay chain-sided; in-chain CONFIRMING prints size DOWN a class (-400..-700) - the bleed has already priced them. (B5) MORE small days than a young crash chain (holds/pauses -200..+300); net drift = marginal new lows. The bleed persists while the fundamental stream re-confirms the old chain; exit requires a TRUE hardened flip confirm.

The class's day-sequencing needs day-N-1 actual tape (bounce carrier, tell) - in one-shot mode only the class-level lean + bands carry. The entry test is a CHAIN STATE ('terminated-to-basing/bleed at the OLD polarity') plus the day's position in a crash/bounce/pause sequence, and the read field says both come off day-N-1 ACTUAL tape - realized nets, price-derived, masked in the blind and served nowhere in the vocabulary. audit.argument: A five-arm rhythm class (B1 crashes arrive single; B2 bounces run 1-2 days never 3; B3 bounce-death gives a full crash band; B4 in-chain confirming prints size down; B5 more small days), each arm supported by a curated list of day-pairs that fit it. n = 2 blocks in ONE winter. The s101_3 block then records a SECOND 3-day counter-run against a B2 call (0203-0205) and re-scopes B2 a second time ('B2 owns BLEED-RHYTHM bounces'; the rest becomes a new FED-RECOVERY band). Two refutations, two post-hoc narrowings, zero retirements. The one full-block forward test scored 6/12 direction with the BLOCK LEAN WRONG - the record's own note says 'the bleed frame carried a down polarity through a block whose intraday nets summed +12,690'. And the caveats concede the structural hole: 'the class has no exit condition - it was carried intact through a block that reversed'.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: THE ARM LISTS, NO - crashes_single, bounces_1_2_days, bounce_death_crash and small_day_prevalence are enumerations of the day-pairs that fit, drawn from the two blocks the class was written on. THE FORWARD TESTS, YES, AND THEY CAME OUT AGAINST IT TWICE - and both times the answer was a new boundary condition rather than a retirement or a scoped refutation. A rule that has never been allowed to fail is not a rule that has been tested.

plays.trigger: a non-zero forecast_run_delta appears in decision_state.weather_forecast
plays.read: whether the run-delta is a FIRST APPEARANCE at a horizon that previously carried no signal, or a REVISION to a shot already in the models and already priced
plays.call: FIRST APPEARANCE (a new shot entering at D+2..D+6 where the prior run had nothing) -> tradeable, side = the sign of the add. REVISION (the same shot being wobbled +-1..3 gw-HDD at horizons it has already occupied for several runs) -> inert; do not let it move the side. The market prices a shot ONCE.
plays.requires: open_time_only
plays.scope: day net (side), as a modifier on the chain read - it does not own the block lean
plays.caveats: This is a CHARACTERIZATION of where the run-delta discriminates, NOT a gate. weather_forecast stays in decision_state in full and permanently; the agent decides how to use it. Works on: first-appearance adds. Does not discriminate on: revisions to a priced shot. A separate limitation, not a property of the signal: the D-1-evening stream is BEHIND the weekend model cycle - the Jan-24 shot first appears in our feed in the 0118-EVENING run, about an hour AFTER the Sunday reopen that already priced it.
plays.falsifier: The play carries no falsifier field, but its probation clause functioned as one and fired: 'the first-appearance arm as a STANDALONE day-net side caller is now 0/3 forward -> DEMOTED per its own probation.' The remaining arm needs the same treatment and the test is cheap: on every day where forecast_run_delta_cdd is within +-0.10 (nominally inert) but the D0 LEVEL moved more than +1.5 gw-CDD from the prior session, score the day-net sign of a rule that treats the day as inert. G22 0624 and 0630 are both such days and both refute it. If more than a couple of such days go the wrong way, the revision arm must be scoped to exclude roll-down of a rising continuous track.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: THE DISCRIMINATOR IS PER-HORIZON AND THE SERVED FIELD IS NOT. The play separates a FIRST APPEARANCE at a horizon that previously carried no signal from a REVISION to a horizon already occupied for several runs; that needs the run-delta LADDER plus each horizon's prior-run occupancy. decision_state carries the ladder only as weather_forecast.run_delta[] (a list of per-horizon dicts) and the vocabulary does not expose it; the vocabulary-legal scalars weather_forecast.forecast_run_delta / forecast_run_delta_cdd are the h0 (D0) values only - verified on 20260622, forecast_run_delta 0.034 == run_delta[0].d_gw_hdd 0.034. The play's ONE numeric bar is the s101_6 pricing-time rule's shock scale ('a first-appearance add prices AT APPEARANCE only at shock scale, run-deltas >= ~3-4 gw-HDD'), and it was measured on FAR-horizon adds: 0119's +4.020 at Jan 23 and +8.511 at Jan 24, i.e. D+4/D+5. Measured across every committed grp*_state.json the h0 scalar spans [-1.267, +0.876] and never once reaches 3, while the horizon ladder reaches 8.511 on the founding day. A >=3 bar on the served scalar would read as evaluated and could never fire - not even on the play's own founding instances. The same field carries the audit's roll-down defect: run_delta compares one target date across two runs and is structurally blind to a shot that arrives by the passage of time, which is what refuted the revision arm on G22 0624 and 0630.

audit.argument: The mechanism is stated crisply and it is checkable: the market prices a weather shot ONCE, so a FIRST APPEARANCE at a previously empty horizon carries information while a REVISION to an already-priced shot does not. The mechanism instance is specific and traced: the 0125 cut (-2.315 at Jan 30) and the 0126 re-add (+3.197 at the same target) cancel to approximately nothing within two runs - 'which is the definition of noise on a priced event, and is the mechanism.' WHAT MAKES THIS ONE DIFFERENT FROM THE REST OF MY BATCH IS THAT IT MEASURED ITSELF AND PAID FOR IT. The s101_3 block scores four G12 uses individually, with two flat MISSES named as misses (0202, 0204) and one scored 'day-net MISS / regime-trajectory HIT'; the probation_resolution then records the first-appearance arm as '0/3 forward as a STANDALONE day-net side caller' and DEMOTES it. A play that writes down its own 0/3 and acts on it is doing the thing this audit is looking for. It also derived a replacement with named n - the s101_6 PRICING-TIME rule (shock adds >= ~3-4 gw-HDD price at appearance, n=2; moderate adds price on entering D+0..D+2, n=1 sequence, back-checked against 1109 and 1123). WHERE IT IS NOW STALE: the surviving revision-inert arm is recorded as 'unchanged, still harmless', and that claim rests on four G12/G13 NON-uses, which cannot hurt by construction. It is contradicted twice in G22, both times by the specialist who fired it. On 0624 C read forecast_run_delta_cdd -0.011 as inert and held the sign DOWN at -200 into a +800 day; C's own refine diagnosed it exactly - 'the target-date forecast never moved; the mass ROLLED DOWN into D0 by the passage of time. forecast_run_delta_cdd measures revisions and is blind to roll-down.' On 0630 C fired the same arm ('the +0.261 gw CDD add sits at horizons the heat has occupied since 0626, so it is inert as a side caller and does not flip the sign') and guessed -420 into a +780 day. The correction C proposed - roll-down is not a revision - is NOT in the brain: the string 'roll-down' appears zero times in knowledge/ng_brain.json.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: YES, AND IT DID. The first-appearance arm's forward record came out against it (0/3) and the record demoted the arm rather than rescuing it - that is a measurement that falsified a claim and was acted on, which is the discriminator for this class. The weaker half is the revision-inert arm, whose support is '4/4 harmless' non-uses; a non-use cannot fail, so that specific evidence could NOT have come out otherwise, and the two G22 instances above are what a real test of it looks like.

audit.argument: TWO DIFFERENT OBJECTS UNDER ONE ID, and they do not share a support class. (1) THE OWNERSHIP LADDER - anchor_structural > positioning_saturation_turn > weekend_cycle_weather > chain_drift - is a genuine decision procedure and it has real forward evidence of correct DECLINES: on G22 0629 both A and B walked the rungs against measured quantities and declined the structural rung on a MEASURED absence (calendar_front_next_spread -0.043 with the front CHEAPENING into its own expiry plus contango on every day of the block - a stranded-premium unwind cannot coexist with a widening contango). That is a rung that could have fired and did not, for a stated reason. (2) THE MAGNITUDE BANDS are the problem, and they are OUTCOME_CREDITED in the strict sense. The evidence is a per-gap back-check table covering EVERY material gap in the walk in which every single actual lands IN its class band - 12 for 12, then 13 for 13 once the s101_6 weather ladder is added, with the file's own note reading 'zero gaps outside their class band' and 'zero re-classifications outside band'. The bands were defined FROM those gaps. A back-check that cannot produce a miss is not a test. The dead-sponsor sizing rule is the honourable exception: it argues a real mechanism, declares n=1 outright, and points at its eleven non-firings as the discriminator - that is a rule with a genuine negative population. But the weather rung, which is the rung that actually owns most gaps, has no such control.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: NOT AS RECORDED - the back-check is in-sample and 13/13 by construction. It HAS come out the other way on the two genuine out-of-sample tests, and both failed on magnitude: G22 0629 (+480 called, +50 delivered) and G23 0713 (+400 called, -360 delivered, sign wrong too). The play's own user retracted the bands mid-corpus - B on 0706 stood the whole play down with 'winter weather bands scope-retracted for summer', which is an in-corpus admission that the bands do not transfer.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: THE BAR IS INTRADAY AND PRE-ONSET; requires = needs_intraday_reveal. The stated test is a failed counter-flush in the final 30-75 min - probes recovering >=60% within 30 min, the session low holding, imbalance normalizing against the session base - all windowed intraday quantities, and the recovery fraction is price-derived besides. The served tape_conditions block is a PRIOR-SESSION aggregate (n_trades, session_b_share, session_signed_flow, big_print_b_share, big_prints_n, trades_per_min, volume_lots, l1_book) with no intraday window and no probe/recovery measure anywhere. The conjunction's other limb, a 'live structural pull state', resolves through squeeze_watch, whose spread limb is genuinely price-masked (calendar_limb_satisfied_live is null on every day of g22 and g23) and whose frozen active flag the S112 audit measured as 10-of-10 or 0-of-10 in every modern block. Neither limb can be written as a bar on a served path; picking a squeeze_watch calendar field to stand in for the flush would name a quantity the play does not test.

audit.argument: Claim: a failed counter-flush in the final 30-75 min, IN CONJUNCTION with a live structural pull state (delivery week / squeeze_watch / crowded short base), precedes squeeze ignition - 3/3 on 0130, 1223, 0129 spanning G9/G11; the flush alone is named NOISE. The retrospective around it is unusually disciplined and I want that on the record: it demotes F6 (trade-rate ramp) and F7 (VWAP posture) to NOISE because they fire on quiet-day controls, demotes F3/F4/F5 to WATCH for failing the spanning requirement, names 1128 as a 'WEAK-TELL INSTANCE, named honestly', names 1020's missing raw tape as a limit, and records G13 as a clean negative block. That is better conduct than most of the corpus. But the play underneath has the outcome-credited shape: the three instances were SELECTED as days that ignited, the pre-onset signature was found looking backwards, and when the one control that challenged it showed the flush-fail ALSO fires on quiet days (0219, 0212), the response was to ADD the conjunction limb rather than retract. The conjunction limb has never itself been varied - all three instances carry it, and no instance exists anywhere where the conjunction fired and ignition did not follow.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: PARTLY, and the part that could is real. The quiet-day controls could have shown the flush-fail was clean and they did not; that measurement was allowed to come out badly and it killed F6, F7 and the compression read. But the SURVIVING rule has no test capable of refuting it: a squeeze-regime day carrying a failed flush that did NOT ignite has never been looked for, and the controls used were quiet days which by construction lack the conjunction's second limb. The version that was falsified is not the version that was kept.

The doubled rung's only instance, 0308 at +2250, comes from the G14 REFINE: the blind that day forecast -750 with the sign wrong by 3000 USD, and the refined v2 pass then wrote +2200 against the +2250 actual. The form was invented in the refine to explain the refine's own predecessor miss, and the brain says as much in its own evidence field - the 0308 'Sunday envelope break' is 'EXPLAINED by the budget form, not declared'. That is honest, and it is also the definition of the class. The plain rung then has the opposite problem: it sits at ~600 while the play's own stated null prior for non-chain-drift Sundays is <= 690. The two are the same number, so the plain rung buys nothing over declining to fire.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Partly, and the part that could did. The play's declared first forward test ran at G15 0322 and PASSED on the framing claim in the sharpest possible way: budget called -600, delivered -640, while the gap was called -400 and delivered +290 - gap_dir_ok false. The companion Sunday 0315 repeated it exactly (-450 called, -430 delivered, gap -300 called, +480 delivered). Two Sundays where the total was right to within 40 USD and the split was inverted both times is real evidence that the day-move is the stable object. But it is evidence for the FRAMING, not for the rungs, and neither number distinguishes the plain rung from the <= 690 prior. The doubled rung has never fired again in the walk.

plays.trigger: the panel (or the running read) SPLITS between a storage/S3-bearish DOWN angle and a weather-cold-add UP angle, inside a CONFIRMED S1-void injection regime (near-window normals base <=~20 gw-HDD AND storage phase = injection AND consensus prints loose/building surplus)
plays.read: (a) near-window (D0..D+3) MAX forecast gw-HDD at the D-1 vintage vs the ~16.4 band-authority threshold (the warm_cut_headroom / shoulder_weather_band_void boundary, applied to the ADD side); (b) the never-masked tape_conditions session_b_share of the immediately-prior session(s) (open-conditions, day-grain DIRECTION nowcast)
plays.call: DEFAULT to the S3-bearish DOWN angle. The weather-cold-add UP angle wins ONLY IF BOTH gates hold: (a) near-window max HDD >= ~16.4 gw (clears the unobserved 13.6-16.4 band into confirmed authority) AND (b) session_b_share >= ~0.50 (a genuine buy-tape confirming the add is being bought). When neither/only-one holds, the cold-add owns AT MOST the single reopen GAP it enters on (weekend_gap_delivery / block_gap_ownership weekend_cycle rung) and earns NO intraday day-lean; revert to the S3 down bleed for the session net. NEVER resolve a flagged split by damping to a middle - pick the gated angle.
plays.mechanism: In S1-void there is no near-window Bcf demand mass for a modest cold-add to sustain an intraday price ramp, so a sub-band add prices ONCE (the reopen gap) and the storage-injection sell-tape reasserts. The never-masked session flow is the discriminator that reveals whether real buying is materializing behind the weather story; absent buy-flow AND band authority, the weather-up angle is a headfake. A damped-middle synthesis is strictly dominated: it is directionally wrong (halfway between right-down and wrong-up lands on the wrong side of flat) AND magnitude-wrong.
plays.requires: open_time_only (near-window forecast vintage + never-masked tape_conditions session_b_share)
plays.scope: synthesis/selector - which angle wins a flagged storage-vs-weather divergence; direction + whether the cold-add earns a day-lean or only a gap
plays.caveats: n=3 splits within one block (+1 positive control). The two gates are pre-existing measured thresholds (16.4 = shoulder_weather_band_void boundary; 0.50 = flow-nowcast neutral) - no new free constant. Scoped to the S3-injection-regime storage-vs-weather split; a WINTER (S1-live) split is governed by the winter weather bands, not this rule. Test on the next block where a cold-add SHOULD win (near-window >= 16.4 AND buy-tape) - the rule must let weather own the day there.
plays.falsifier: The brain's falsifier field is EMPTY. The caveats field supplies the right test and it has never been run: 'Test on the next block where a cold-add SHOULD win (near-window >= 16.4 AND buy-tape) - the rule must let weather own the day there.' Measured, that block does not exist in the corpus and cannot: the conjunction is 0 of 82. So the play's own designed positive test is unreachable, which is itself the falsification. audit.argument: THIS IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FINDING IN MY BATCH, because the play is a SELECTOR - the machinery that decides which angle wins a bimodal split - and its up-arm has never been reachable. The rule defaults a storage-versus-weather split to the S3-bearish DOWN angle, and lets the weather-cold-add UP angle win ONLY IF BOTH gates hold: (a) near-window D0..D+3 max forecast gw-HDD >= ~16.4, AND (b) session_b_share >= ~0.50. I evaluated both gates day by day on every staged group that serves them. GATE (a) FIRES 0 OF 10 IN G18, 0 OF 10 IN G19, 0 OF 10 IN G20, 0 OF 10 IN G21, 0 OF 10 IN G22 AND 0 OF 10 IN G23 - zero of sixty, with block maxima of 11.46, 6.06, 2.95, 0.80, 0.37 and 0.24 against a 16.4 bar. In the winter blocks it is degenerate the other way, 12 of 12 in G12 and 12 of 12 in G13. It splits days only in the shoulder, 8 of 12 in G14 and 7 of 12 in G15. In the BIRTH BLOCK G16 it fires on exactly ONE day out of eleven - 0405, at 16.93 - and that one day is the play's own named positive control. GATE (b) fires 3 of 88 served sessions (3.4%), which is the S108 normalization defect the brain already records. THE CONJUNCTION - the up-angle unlock, the entire discriminating content of the selector - IS SATISFIED ON 0 OF THE 82 DAY-ROWS across nine staged groups where both gates are evaluable. It has never once been possible for the weather angle to win. The evidence field is 'n: 3 splits IN this block, all resolved DOWN correctly by the gates' - and I verified all three against g16_score.json (0401 -600, 0406 -470, 0407 -220, exact). But G16 closed DOWN on 10 of 11 days (-790, -650, -110, -600, -130, +400, -470, -220, -450, -610, -190). A gate that can only ever emit DOWN, scored on a block that was down 91% of the time, gets 3 of 3 by construction. The brain's own negative_result_reported blames gate (b) and names the G20 symptom (sub-0.50 on 10 of 10 in a block that rallied +1,860) without identifying that gate (a) is worse and unconditional. AND THE CORPUS ALREADY KNEW: grp21_mbo_specialist_C wrote 'selector.divergence_resolution arm (a)... cannot fire in June by construction - the same failure shape as the b_share bar that was just fixed, on the other axis.' That was scoped to one block and never reached the brain.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: NO, and this is the strongest form of the failure. The play's three supporting instances all resolve DOWN because DOWN is the only output the gates can produce; the 'positive control' 0405 clears gate (a) but fails gate (b), so it is not a control on the rule as written either. There is no configuration of the served data, on any of 82 evaluable day-rows across nine groups, in which the evidence could have come out UP. An arm that cannot fire cannot be wrong, and cannot be right.

plays.trigger: sizing a CHAIN-SIDED (agreeing-with-the-running-down-chain) session in a CONFIRMED S1-void spring INJECTION block (near-window normals base <=~20 gw AND storage phase inject AND loose/building prints) where the never-masked tape_conditions session_b_share is SUB-0.50 (a live sell-tape)
plays.read: day-class (trend session vs coil/realization/lull vs print-day) + the never-masked D-1 session_b_share (live-chain confirmation) + whether the print/catalyst was pre-priced/front-run
plays.call: Do NOT damp a chain-sided down day to a stub. A live sell-tape (session_b < 0.50) chain-sided day delivers its full shoulder band by day-class: TREND session band ~ -450..-780 (non-coil day-class: reopen carry, Monday carry, pre-print front-run, post-cold softening, high-activity building-surplus print); COIL/realization band ~ -100..-250 (pre-print coil off a near-neutral D-1, a pre-priced/front-run print that round-trips, a sub-band crest realization, a Friday range). The S2 cold-add reopen is the sole UP, and only as a GAP (see selector.divergence_resolution / weekend_gap_delivery).
plays.mechanism: S1-void removes the seasonal amplifier but NOT the storage-trajectory lean; the injection-bearish backdrop plus a persistent sell-tape is a live down-chain, and a live chain delivers its class band. The G15 'do-not-over-size the shoulder' lesson is scoped to COUNTER/print days (shoulder_counter_print_damping) - applying it as a UNIFORM damp under-sizes every chain-sided trend day, which produced the blind's +2365 systematic under-drift. The trend-vs-coil split is set by day-class + catalyst structure, NOT by session_b magnitude (session_b is a DIRECTION nowcast; the within-band exact is leg-grain).
plays.requires: open_time_only for the class; the sell-tape confirmation is the never-masked tape_conditions session_b_share (open-conditions)
plays.scope: magnitude (day-net band) of a chain-sided down session in an S1-void injection bleed
plays.caveats: n=1 block (G16). The bands are wide and honest; the WITHIN-band exact day magnitude is NOT derivable from session-grain state (it is leg-grain, creds-gated) - declared a band-position irreducible. Distinct from shoulder_counter_print_damping (that damps COUNTER prints to flat; this sizes CHAIN-SIDED days to their band). The trend/coil day-class assignment is the deliverable, not a point number.
plays.falsifier: The brain's falsifier field is EMPTY, and the play's own stated forward test ('the bands must hold on the next confirmed S1-void injection block with a persistent sub-0.50 sell-tape') was never scored even though G17 and G18 both qualified and both ran it. Concrete falsifiers: (1) score the 15 G17/G18 fires I list above and write the result into forward_evidence, which currently still says NONE; (2) re-express the S1-void limb seasonally - HDD base in the shoulder, CDD base in summer - or scope the play out of summer entirely; (3) settle the inverted two_sided bar with the conditional test (down-days only) rather than my marginal, since if it inverts conditionally too the sell-tape confirmation limb should be struck rather than re-based.

That is a threshold sited by counterexample rather than by fit. The mechanism itself is thin - the play describes the forecaster's error ('the blind reads a big directional close as MOMENTUM') more than it describes the market - but the sign claim is separated from the size claim honestly: 'the robust decision-time claim is the SIGN ... the counter-move SIZE is variable (-13 to -106 percent) so band it, do not point-forecast'.

And neither operand is served: no last_hour_* field exists anywhere in the vocabulary; last_hour_dir/last_hour_signed_flow live only in the refine-only g*_exit_states.json, which is why the play's own instances record it standing down 5 of 5 in the blind. audit.argument: On a mid-week turn day the prior session's last_hour_dir gates MAGNITUDE: an opposing prior exit means the reversal realizes post-open, so size the confirmed base and never front-run the reactive tail; an aligned exit means momentum carries, so do not cap. The headline support is 'n: 6 opposing-exit reversal days (all D-1 lhd<=0) across g9, g10, g12, g15 = a strikingly consistent signature: EVERY clean mid-week reversal-up day in the record had a prior session that exited DOWN.' That is a base-rate artifact and it is the most important finding in this batch after flow_nowcast. The mechanism was inferred from which days delivered, and the word 'clean' does the selecting.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Barely. last_hour_dir is -1 on 25 of 40 modern sessions, and over consecutive within-group pairs the prior exited down on 22 of 36 = 61 percent. A claim of the form 'every reversal-up day had a prior exiting down' on n=6 is close to what six random draws give you. And the structure forecloses disconfirmation: the aligned counter-case (g9 0223) is quoted as its own separate arm, so no observation in the record can fall outside one of the two arms.

The diagnostic number quoted ('~70% of misses across C/D/E were signals SEEN and not acted on') is a retrospective attribution of misses to a cause the play was written to name. || AND THE FORWARD FIELD CARRIES THE S108 SIGNATURE IN ONE SENTENCE: 'G17 refine r2: the HE24->HE1 coordination halved error 24->11 (10/10) WITH ZERO DIRECTION CHANGES - the mid-block re-derivation working.' YES for the four blind fires, which were scored and went 2/4, and YES for the declines, which were real refusals on stated grounds and were correct. The play's genuine evidence is its declines; its claimed evidence is an improvement it cannot have caused.

plays.read: a covering / exhaustion give-back is a ONE-SHOT (1-2 session) event, NOT a standing weekly UP bias. The turn/exhaustion gate flips the SIGN of the TURN day; it does not license re-firing the covering-UP on the next weekend-feeding Friday
plays.call: once positioning_spent_fade is emitted (covering realized, monday_bias down), the FOLLOWING weekend-feeding day reverts to the chain/state default UNLESS a FRESH crowding stack rebuilt since (new COT extreme AND worsening, new one-sided run into it). A still-extreme-but-NOT-worsening COT is spent fuel, not new fuel. An expiry the week ahead = squeeze TAIL risk (fat upper tail), not a p50 covering trigger
plays.requires: prior handoff_out exit_type + monday_bias, COT trajectory (worsening vs flat), D-1 big_print - all open_time
plays.scope: the SECOND weekend-feeding day after a covering give-back; leaves the first (correct) covering flip intact
plays.confidence: the spent-vs-fresh COT read across the specialist's own handoff seam is the discriminator; FREE
plays.falsifier: The brain's falsifier field is EMPTY, and this play's confidence slot holds PROSE where every other play holds a float ('the spent-vs-fresh COT read across the specialist's own handoff seam is the discriminator; FREE'), so it carries no numeric confidence at all - a record defect worth fixing on its own. Proposed falsifier: a weekend-feeding day following a positioning_spent_fade, with COT still extreme but NOT worsening, that nonetheless delivers a covering-UP of >= the original give-back's size. Zero such days in G17-G23; that is the claim.

plays.trigger: a session (esp. a Friday close, weekend seam, or catch-up window) where signed flow is heavy but OPPOSES the price move
plays.read: the discriminator is signed-flow-vs-price CONVICTION (absorption), NOT raw imbalance. Near-identical heavy flow can deliver opposite signs: (a) SELL flow ABSORBED under a rising/holding price = crowded-short COVERING -> price delivers the covered direction UP; (b) BUY flow ABSORBED under a falling price = buy-absorption FAILING -> stays DOWN (not accumulation until price actually turns); (c) flow ALIGNED with price = genuine delivery, the flow direction wins
plays.call: read the covered/failing/delivered state from final-phase conviction, not the imbalance sign. A crowded short (MM net < ~12 1y-pctile) whose covering is ABSORBED-not-spent at the Friday close reprices UP on the Monday catch-up (weekend gap and/or 06-10 window) - buy-absorption at the close is a DIRECTIONAL tell, not exhaustion. Its mirror: buy-absorbed-failing stays down until price turns.
plays.requires: signed flow + price by phase (refine/live); the blind has the flow (decision-legit) but must pair it with its own price forecast
plays.scope: direction on covering/absorption days; the discriminator is conviction not imbalance
plays.confidence: strong cross-specialist convergence (A/B/C/E) on one block; the absorption read needs price (refine/live) - the blind gets the flow and infers against its own forecast
plays.falsifier: None written, and this play needs one badly because its main flag is derived from the quantity it predicts. Two candidates. (1) FORWARD FORM, blind-legal: over all crowded-short Fridays (MM pctile < 12) in g18-g23, score whether final-phase absorption calls the Monday day-move sign. The arm fires once (0501 -> 0504, correct) and its aligned counterpart fires once (0508 -> 0511, wrong), which is 1-of-2 and not a test. (2) SEPARATE THE FLAG FROM THE OUTCOME: score absorb_session on day D against day D+1's direction, which does not reuse D+1's price. I ran it across g18-g23 and got 8 of 18 - at chance. A play whose discriminator is computed from realized price must be scored on a LATER day than the one that built it, and no evidence in this record does that.

audit.argument: The claim is that signed-flow-versus-price CONVICTION (absorption), not raw imbalance, is the direction discriminator: sell flow absorbed under a rising price is crowded-short covering and delivers UP, buy flow absorbed under a falling price is failing and stays DOWN, aligned flow delivers in its own direction. EVERY NUMBER IN THE EVIDENCE FIELD REPRODUCES EXACTLY from g18_mbo_evidence.json and g18_actual.json - 0501 total_sflow -3,358 with day_move +280 and absorb_session true; 0508 total_sflow -3,214 with day_move -370 and absorb_session false; the 'near-identical -3300 flow, opposite signs' pairing is real; 0427 +370 and 0504 +610 with gap +440; the C mirror 0429/0505/0506 all carry positive total_sflow with negative day_move and absorb_session true. The derivation is honest and traceable. THE PROBLEM IS THAT THE DISCRIMINATOR IS COMPUTED FROM THE OUTCOME. absorb_session and ph_absorb are flags derived from flow-versus-realized-price disagreement, so 'sell flow ABSORBED under a rising price delivered UP' is very close to a restatement of what the flag means. The play concedes the dependency in its requires field ('signed flow + price by phase (refine/live)') and its evidence line makes the credit explicit: 'The refine flipped every one; the price-walled blind (which sees flow but not price) called them the raw-imbalance way and missed.' All of its evidence is from G18, the block it was derived on. I TESTED THE ONE FORWARD-FACING FORM. The `call` contains a genuine next-session claim: a crowded short (MM 1y pctile < ~12) whose covering is absorbed at the Friday close reprices UP on the Monday catch-up. Across the eleven Fridays of g18-g23 the crowded-short SELL-absorbed branch fires exactly ONCE - 0501, MM pctile 8.49, final-phase absorption true, sell flow -3,358 - and that fire is the in-sample founding instance. It never arms again: 0508/0515/0605/0612/0619 carry no final-phase absorption; 0529 (16.04), 0626 (25.47), 0703 (29.25) and 0710 (44.34) fail the crowded-short gate outright; and the one other armed Friday, 0522, is the MIRROR branch (buy flow +349 absorbed, MM 0.94, so 'stays down') and its Monday 0525 came in +30, i.e. flat rather than down. Generalizing to 'does absorb_session on day D call day D+1' across g18-g23 gives 8 of 18 - a coin flip. TO ITS CREDIT, the play carries an S108-signature self-correction inside it: assumption_retired_timing_limb withdraws D's pre-print timing claim after the per-leg check refuted it 1 of 4, and names the disease exactly - 'G20 credited the generator from DAY NETS; the intraday check was never run.'
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: MOSTLY NO. The flag that does the sorting is built from the price the flag is used to predict, so on a same-session read the evidence is near-tautological; and the sample is one block, chosen because that block was a covering rally. What COULD have come out otherwise is the forward Friday-to-Monday arm, and it has never been given the chance - it arms once in six blocks and that once is in-sample. The retired timing limb is the exception that proves the record can measure honestly: a per-leg decomposition refuted it and the play recorded the refutation against its own author.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: No threshold, and the quantity that decides it is not served. flow_conviction = sign(signed_flow) * sign(price_change) computed PER PHASE from the MBO phase table; the comparison is against zero, i.e. a sign test on a product of two signs, so nothing in it is a bar on a magnitude. HALF the input exists and half cannot: tape_conditions.phase_signed_flow is served on g18-g23 (array-valued, which is why it is not in the scalar vocabulary listing), but there is NO price-change quantity anywhere in the state - tape_conditions declares itself 'NON-PRICE ... no price/return content', price being the blind's one deliberate mask - so the discriminating operand is absent. The play's own caveats say exactly this: 'REFINE-side gate: requires realized price. The blind cannot compute it.' tape_conditions.session_signed_flow is the nearest-looking legal name and it is the WRONG QUANTITY: a whole-session aggregate of the PRIOR day's tape with no price term at all, so a condition pointed there would read as evaluated while measuring something the play never claims. Separately worth recording: the S112 audit measured the gate's OUTPUT to be sign(price_change) on 70 of 70 sessions, so even with both operands served the aligned and negative branches never disagree - a D23 degeneracy sitting in the call rather than the trigger, which no state_path can express.

audit.argument: Per phase, flow_conviction = sign(signed_flow) * sign(price_change); ALIGNED (>0) delivers the band in the FLOW direction, NEGATIVE (<0) means flow was absorbed against price so the move reverses in the PRICE direction. Absorption is a real microstructure object and the play is right that it matters. But the two branches emit the SAME SIGN. Aligned means the two agree, so 'the flow direction' IS the price direction; negative means they disagree, and the call is explicitly the price direction. Whatever the conviction field reads, the output is sign(price_change). I verified this mechanically on all 70 sessions of g17-g23 from the committed evidence files: at ph2 the emitted sign equals the phase price direction 70 of 70 times, and at the max-volume phase 70 of 70. Support is then a day-net tally - 'flow_conviction called 10/10 signs on G19', n_days 10 - which is the OUTCOME_CREDITED shape, and which does not reproduce: applied as written it scores 8 of 10 on G19 at ph2 and 8 of 10 at the max-volume phase. Something other than the play got the last two. Confidence 0.86.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: The 10/10 could have come out lower - and mechanically it does (8/10). But the DISCRIMINATING claim cannot be tested at all, because aligned and negative phases never disagree about the sign, so no arrangement of outcomes can separate them. Across g17-g23 the rule as written scores 81.4 pct at ph2 and 84.3 pct at the max-volume phase on the day sign, splitting 38 aligned / 32 negative at ph2 with near-identical hit rates (31/38 vs 26/32) - i.e. the conviction label carries no lift over 'the dominant phase's price direction wins'. To the brain's credit, the record already contains the antidote for the OTHER arm: B's adjudication shows the final-phase arm's 4-of-4 rests on a confound (all four G20 exemplars carry negative ph3 flow, so A's and D's opposite readings are observationally identical on 4 of 4), that 24 of 24 intra-week boundaries carry |gap| <= 10 'identically zero by market structure' so D scoped the arm on eight vacuous cases, that both readings go 2/4 on the four scorable weekend seams, and it is filed UNRESOLVED with no scope change merged. That is exactly the discipline the core arm never got.

plays.trigger: a multi-session crowded-short covering rally with a running cum_from_anchor
plays.read: extension state (cum_from_anchor, chain age) CROSSED with realized flow_conviction; book polarity is never a standalone sign
plays.call: The covering-absorption UP tell is NOT unconditional - its SIGN flips with EXTENSION. Young/low-extension (cum low, age <=2): buyers absorbing a dip = short-covering UP. Maximally extended (cum high ~>+2000 vs block anchor AND age >=5) with the absorption tell ITSELF reversed (aligned-down delivery, or big BUY absorbed under falling price): the identical signature = late chasers absorbed = DISTRIBUTION DOWN. Extension alone does NOT flip it - while sell is still absorbed under rising price and COT WoW still worsens, covering stays UP. PRE-WARNING: a rally day whose SESSION conviction is negative (sflow opposite the day's price) is a terminal-squeeze signature - kill the covering-UP prior for the next extended session.
plays.scope: crowded-short covering regimes
plays.caveats: The flip needs BOTH extension AND a reversed absorption tell; age/cum alone is a false trigger (0519 would have been wrongly flipped).
plays.falsifier: The play carries NO falsifier field, but its forward field states the test in the right shape ('rides G20+; n=3 within one block, needs a second block') and its caveats name the false-trigger guard ('the flip needs BOTH extension AND a reversed absorption tell; age/cum alone is a false trigger - 0519 would have been wrongly flipped'). The honest falsifier: a maximally-extended session with a reversed absorption tell that continues UP. It has not been testable since G20 because the cum bar has been unreachable.

Three days, one block, and all three readings were produced by the REFINE with the realized price curve in hand. But the discriminator has three free terms (a cum bar, an age bar, and absorption-reversal) fitted to three days by a refine that knew all three answers. One term per observation is a guaranteed fit. audit.argument: A statistical mechanism is argued and then measured against it. big_print_b_share is a proportion, so its dispersion is governed by the number of big prints behind it; on a thin tape it wanders from 0.50 for purely sampling reasons and an absolute 0.55 bar silently becomes a looser bar. The record supplies counts, per-quartile dispersions, equal-fire-rate bars, a correlation, and a stated falsifier. I RE-RAN THE WHOLE MEASUREMENT from the committed 204-row dataset renders/ng_refine_s95/bshare_rows.json. Pooled: n=204 spanning 20251103-20260720, mean 0.461, sd 0.169, p50 0.479, 0.55 at the 72.5th percentile firing on 27.5% of sessions - EVERY ONE OF THOSE EXACT. Thinnest quartile (bigs 1-20, median 9): sd 0.255, fire rate 31.4% - both EXACT. The other three quartiles: my sd 0.134 / 0.119 / 0.126 against the record's 0.132 / 0.120 / 0.127. corr(|b_share - 0.50|, log big_prints_n) = -0.488 against the record's -0.465. The equal-rate bars and the fire-rate spread differ modestly with quartile-boundary handling (my fixed-bar spread 9.8pp against the record's 7.9pp; my guarded spread 7.8pp against 4.5pp), so the guard's benefit is somewhat smaller than recorded but the shape - a STEP confined to the thinnest quartile, flat across the other three - is exactly reproduced. MOST IMPORTANTLY THE RECORDED NEGATIVE RESULT REPRODUCES: the elegant 0.50 + k/sqrt(n) form is worse than the crude fixed bar at every k tested (my per-quartile spreads 19.6 / 23.5 / 23.5 / 17.6pp against a fixed-bar 9.8pp; the record's 18.5 / 22.4 / 22.3 / 16.3 against 7.9), and for the reason the record gives - it over-corrects the thick tail and ends up firing MOST on the thickest quartile. The record is also unusually honest about effect size: 'the guard is a modest, targeted correction - it is NOT a large effect and should not be sold as one.' ONE CLAIM IN THE FORWARD FIELD DOES NOT HOLD. The four-lens G20 note says Memorial Day 20260525 (0.599 on 13 big prints) 'is G20's only reading clearing 0.55'. On the committed size-weighted state, session 20260602 also reads 0.585 on 122 big prints - a thick tape that clears 0.55 and that the guard does not touch. The 0.599-on-13 number itself is exact, as is 'then came in -190' for 0526, and the degenerate Sunday-stub readings of exactly 1.0 on 1 big print (0524 at 658 trades, 0531 at 1,224 trades).
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: YES, DECISIVELY, AND PART OF IT DID. The thinnest quartile could have carried the same dispersion as the others - it carries double. The bar could have floated by season - the record tested that and found it does not (my recomputation: 25.3% winter, and the shoulder/summer split differs from the record's with a different month boundary but the conclusion is the same). And the author's preferred smooth form was tested FIRST and LOST badly to the crude one, and the loss was written down so nobody re-proposes it. That is the cleanest example of Result Discipline in the batch. The dataset is committed, so the measurement is re-runnable by anyone - which is exactly what I did.

My sweep of the stated conjunction over all 70 sessions of g17-g23 returns exactly ONE fire (g20 0529) and zero in the other six blocks, so the degenerate-block share is 6 of 7. legacy_notes.conditions_note: BOTH limbs carry hard numeric bars and NEITHER quantity is in the served vocabulary, so there is no legal state_path for either. Limb (a) is the ratio of final-phase |net| to the prior phase's, bar ~5 percent: tape_conditions.phase_signed_flow IS present in all six modern blocks but as a LIST, which the vocabulary builder does not descend into, so no path resolves to a phase element. Limb (b) - final-phase volume at or above the session maximum, recorded as MANDATORY ('without it the play is a false-positive machine') - needs tape_conditions.phase_volume_lots, and I verified it exists in g22 and g23 ONLY, 2 of 6 modern blocks. audit.argument: When both aggressor sides fight to a draw at MAXIMUM volume and price still travels, the travel belongs to the resting book, not to either aggressor - conviction UNDEFINED BY CANCELLATION rather than by absence. Two mandatory limbs: (a) final-phase |net| below ~5 pct of the prior phase's, AND (b) final-phase volume at or above the session maximum. This is a genuinely argued mechanism with a named first instance, a written falsifier, and - unusually - a documented adversarial history: it was proposed as FLOWLESS_BID_WITHDRAWAL, B refuted the name and the participation reading, E conceded the fact and rejected the consequence, and the merged form is the conjunction the two ledgers reconcile to. Status PROPOSED, n=1, honestly labelled.

This is the shape D23 asks for, arrived at from the other direction: not a value bar at all.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: The bar is real, numeric and unusually clean - assert a cum-keyed RUNG only at k <= 3 sessions from the block anchor, widen or stand down from k >= 4 - but the quantity is NOT SERVED ANYWHERE. k is a schedule position, sessions-from-block-anchor, and the vocabulary carries zero paths matching 'anchor' or 'cum'; the anchor itself lives in the per-group g*_anchor.json build artifact, not in the decision state. The play's own health note reaches the same conclusion from the other direction: 'it needs no served market quantity... not a value bar at all.' squeeze_watch.sessions_since_prompt_expiry is the nearest-looking name in the vocabulary and measures a different thing entirely (sessions since the prompt contract expired, not since the block anchor); naming it would be precisely the hole-#8 error this slot exists to prevent.

audit.argument: A deterministic SCHEDULE rather than a signal: a play keyed on cum_from_anchor or chain extension may assert a RUNG only for k <= 3 sessions from the block anchor; from k >= 4 it widens to the full band or stands down. It rests on a single aggregate measurement - mean |constructed cum - realized cum| by k across G17-G20 - plus the structural observation that k is known in advance in a one-shot block blind, so nothing has to be inferred at runtime. It is one of only two plays in this batch whose evidence is a re-runnable aggregate over committed files rather than a narrative of days, and it is the only one that also carries a written forward test with an explicit kill condition.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Yes, decisively, and in two separate ways. A flat divergence profile would have killed it outright. A smooth accumulation would have made the k<=3 boundary arbitrary - independent random-walk accumulation of uncorrelated daily errors predicts only about 1.15x growth at the k=3 to k=4 step, against the 2.13x measured in the derivation set and 1.91x forward. Neither null happened, so the kink is real and is evidence of CORRELATED (block-lean) error rather than mechanical accumulation - which is the play's implicit mechanism and it survives its own null.

audit.argument: The microstructure mechanism is sound and I want that said first: a large resting order is filled BY the crowd, so a program working the offer prints aggressor-BUY while price falls. That is correct market mechanics and it generalises a case A had already named for covering shorts. The instances are real and traced: G21 0608 printed +3,261 of net aggressor buy while falling -890 with absorb_session TRUE, and G23 0715 printed +6,326 of buy - the block's largest tilt - and closed -60 on BCOM roll day 5, with C matching the ph2 fingerprint to within ten units of 0608 (+2,858/-120 versus +2,868/+40). WHAT IS NOT TESTED IS THE DISCRIMINATION, which is where the play's whole content lives: the claim is not that aggressor tilts invert, it is that they invert ON PROGRAM DAYS, so a same-signed tilt there is SUSPECT. I ran that directly. Joining g*_mbo_evidence.json total_sflow to g*_actual.json day moves gives 59 sessions in g18-g23 with both a nonzero tilt and a nonzero move. On the 21 program-or-expiry days the tilt AGREES with the day sign 12 times (57.1%). On the 38 other days it agrees 13 times (34.2%). So the aggressor tilt inverts 65.8% of the time on ORDINARY days and only 42.9% of the time on program days - the inversion is a general property of this tape and program days are, if anything, the LEAST inverted. Per group, never pooled as the conclusion, the program-day agreement rate is greater than or equal to the non-program rate in five of six blocks (g18 1/3 vs 0/7, g19 3/4 vs 2/6, g20 1/2 vs 3/8, g21 2/5 vs 2/5, g22 1/1 vs 4/8, g23 4/6 vs 2/4). The play named the two program days out of twenty-one that inverted. And its own third instance points the same way: 0714 fired limb one of the play's falsifier (tilt +3,747 buy, day +200 up, on a GSCI-and-BCOM roll day) and was set aside on limb two, 'the program is demonstrably the dominant participant' - a condition no served field measures. C was right not to bank a falsification it could not show; the defect is that the falsifier was written with a limb that can never be evaluated.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: For the mechanism, yes, and it holds - a 65.8% baseline inversion rate is a real, falsifiable property of this tape and it is the play's genuine contribution. For the DISCRIMINATION, no: two program days were selected from twenty-one by their outcome, the control condition was never run, and the falsifier's second limb is unmeasurable. When I run the control it comes out against the play at 57.1% versus 34.2% - which at n=21 versus n=38 is about 1.7 sigma, so not decisive, but it certainly is not support.

plays.trigger: any session. The vessel line is the ONLY LIVE LNG channel in the state - read it whenever the export term could matter, and ALWAYS on a week where departures or capacity step.
plays.read: ngwu_balance.lng_vessels_departed and lng_vessel_capacity_bcf (Vortexa tanker tracker, published by EIA in the WNGSR Supplement). Weekly cadence. Read the STEP, not the level: departures x capacity is realized export throughput, so a liquefaction outage or a restart shows up here within a week even though feedgas nominations are not available.
plays.call: TREAT AS CONTEXT, NOT AS A SIGNAL. There is no forward evidence that this channel sorts direction or sizes magnitude - it has never been tested. Use it to avoid being blind to a large export move, and to flag when the export term is changing under a forecast that assumes it static. Do NOT fire a direction or a band off it. If it steps hard against your thesis, say so and widen, rather than resolving it in your own favour.
plays.mechanism: LNG feedgas is structurally one of the biggest modern NG drivers (a Freeport-class outage reprices the curve for months - S97 item 8). The live feedgas line DIED with the S&P section of the free weekly balance on 2025-10-02: ngwu_balance.lng_feedgas_bcfd is null, and the only feedgas figure carried (16.3) sits in latest_sd_levels at week_ending 2025-09-24, 278 days stale and self-declared sd_live:false. The VESSEL line survived that death and still advances. Departures x capacity is a coarse, lagging, but REAL measure of the same physical export throughput. S109 addendum (Greg): the two things that will move this line next are Gulf hurricanes hitting the Gulf Coast liquefaction fleet, and a Middle East supply hole pulling additional US cargoes. Both are exactly the case where feedgas would be the right instrument and is unavailable - which is why the throughput proxy is worth having.
plays.scope: All seasons, and TWO live forward drivers make it more informative from here, not less (Greg, S109). (1) GULF HURRICANE SEASON: the US liquefaction fleet is Gulf Coast - Sabine Pass, Corpus Christi, Freeport, Cameron - so a storm track through the Gulf hits export capacity and Gulf production at the same time, and the two pull gas price in OPPOSITE directions. Departures are the observable that separates them: a terminal outage shows up as departures collapsing while production returns. Season is Aug-Oct and it is live NOW. (2) A MIDDLE EAST SUPPLY HOLE pulling cargoes: if that supply is short, more US cargoes leave, export throughput rises and the pull is bullish US gas. Both are STEP events, which is what this line reads. It remains a SLOWER term than the weather/renewables stack.
plays.caveats: WEEKLY resolution, so it cannot time a day. It LAGS the physical event - a cargo departs after liquefaction has already run. Capacity is fleet-mix dependent, so a capacity step is not necessarily a throughput step. And it is a THROUGHPUT proxy, not a feedgas nomination: it will miss an outage that has begun but not yet shown up in departures. AND THE HURRICANE CASE IS THE ONE IT IS WEAKEST ON: departures LAG, so a terminal that shuts today shows up in this line days later, while the price reacts to the storm track immediately. Treat it as CONFIRMATION of an export disruption, never as the early warning. We carry NO tropical/hurricane feed at all - freeze_risk is the winter analogue and has no summer counterpart. Named gap.
plays.confidence: none-yet (monitoring). No forward evidence exists. Explicitly NOT promoted on the basis of plausibility.

audit.argument: This is a DATA-HANDLING RULE about how to read a served field, not a market conditional. Its call - 'seam weather reads use LEVEL differences only; run deltas are intra-week instruments' - makes no claim about price, direction or magnitude, so no day-net observation can bear on it. It is also already served by the pipeline: weather_forecast_cycle.weekday_open.seam_delta_warning carries the identical instruction verbatim on EVERY day of grp22_state.json (I checked 0626, 0629 and 0630 - byte-identical text: 'run deltas baseline run-over-run, NOT session-over-session. Across a weekend/holiday seam use the LEVEL difference... never these deltas'). So the entry duplicates a warning string the state already prints, which makes it an A-7 / D30 question about where doctrine lives rather than a support-classification question. ITS TRACED INSTANCE IS EXACT. G22 0629: forecast_run_delta_cdd -0.219 against a D0 CDD level rise of 14.815 - 10.076 = +4.739 (the record says +4.7); and 'mechanism verified on 0624 (level +2.205, field -0.011)' reproduces to three decimals (10.022 - 7.817 = 2.205; d_gw_cdd h0 = -0.011). If Greg rules that instrument-reading rules ARE plays, then on the evidence this is a NOVEL_N1 with a partial refutation, and I would not argue with that reading - I am classifying on what the entry IS, not on how well it is evidenced. TWO SUBSTANTIVE PROBLEMS EITHER WAY. (1) The stated mechanism - across a multi-cycle seam 'the channel is STRUCTURALLY ~ZERO' - does not hold on the corpus's other clean seam: 20260713 carries d_gw_cdd h0 = +0.435, one of the larger deltas in g23, against a level difference of -0.778 in the OPPOSITE direction. Mean |h0 run delta| on the two clean seams is 0.327 against 0.251 on the sixteen intra-week days of g22/g23 - the seam deltas are if anything LARGER, not structurally zero. (2) The two quantities are not comparable by construction: the run delta compares the SAME target date across two runs, while 'D0 vs the prior session's D0' compares DIFFERENT target dates. They measure different things, so they should disagree everywhere, which is what the falsifier trips over below.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: PARTLY. The seam instance is arithmetic and reproduces, so it could have failed to reproduce and did not. But the claim as a whole cannot be scored against any market outcome, and the one empirical part of it - that the delta channel is structurally near-zero across a seam - was NOT tested against the corpus before merging: the record cites one seam (0629) and one intra-week day (0624), and the second clean seam in the same corpus (0713) goes the other way.

(4) THE CLEANEST EVIDENCE IS PRE-GRAFT AND INSIDE THE PLAY'S OWN EVIDENCE LIST, C-0715: G22 0624 and 0625 carry the IDENTICAL served burn of 39.3 with 0625 on lower wind, and delivered +800 and -60 on consecutive sessions - the play cites 0624 and is silent on its twin. WHY IT FAILED (E's mechanism, corroborated by D-0716 and C-0714): the gate reads burn as a NUMERATOR WITH NO BALANCE-CLEARING DENOMINATOR, so when the balance loosens at the demand peak, burn confirmation is BEARISH information; +1.0 Bcf/d is 2.3% of burn against storage of 2,983 in injection season, which is why the numerator is always positive and always small. WHAT SURVIVES: the DAMPER limb (0709/0710 both wind-ramping, both fell) - carried forward inside weather.burn_is_demand_arrival_not_direction. Retired rather than amended because the failure is the play's core claim, not its calibration. ||| THE DISSENT, RECORDED IN FULL BECAUSE IT CORRECTS THE TALLY (Greg, S110: 'record the instance where the one had it right and the four said it was wrong and why they were wrong'). ONE specialist dissented: C-0707 returned MIS-SCOPED, NOT REFUTED, and it was RIGHT on the point it made. Its argument: the blind confirmed the gate off a HOLIDAY-SUNDAY grid row (period 2026-07-05) that the gate's OWN weekday-normalization rule disqualifies; read on the valid comparator in the same row (gas_chg_7d_mwh +1,012,635, Sunday-over-Sunday by construction) the gate CONFIRMED, and its day delivered +160 UP. C-0707 stated plainly: 'the falsifier is NOT discharged on my day (a burn-confirmed CDD add that DID deliver)', and it DECLINED to bank a refutation on the nearest candidate (0708) because that day is roll-confounded. WHY THE OTHER FOUR WERE WRONG ON THE TALLY: the refuting record was built as '3 clean up-fires, 0 of 3 delivered' (0708, 0715, 0716) with 0706 excluded as unevaluable - and 0707, a clean fire that DID deliver, was counted by NOBODY, because it was not any refuter's own day and each specialist works only its own causal slice. CORRECTED RECORD: 1 of 4 delivered, not 0 of 3. THE RETIREMENT STILL STANDS, AND THAT IS THE POINT: it does not rest on the tally. The two arguments that kill the play are MECHANISM arguments and survive C-0707's instance untouched - (a) D-0709's constant limb (d_gw_cdd h1 positive 20/20 across two groups; a limb that never changes sign cannot gate, so the gate cannot have been what discriminated on 0707 either - something else carried that day), and (b) C-0715's pre-graft pair from inside the play's own evidence list (G22 0624 and 0625, IDENTICAL served burn 39.3, delivered +800 and -60 on consecutive sessions). A play can be right on a day and still be an instrument that cannot discriminate. LESSON RECORDED: per-day causal isolation means no specialist sees another's instance, so any TALLY assembled from independent slices is systematically incomplete - counts must be RECOMPUTED AT THE COORDINATOR across all ten days before any tally-based claim is merged. Mechanism claims are unaffected by this.

legacy_notes.conditions_note: THE CLASSIFIER'S PRICE LEG IS THE BLIND'S DELIBERATE MASK. Both halves need price. The trigger, 'the session after a D-1 up-leg', requires D-1 price direction, which is not served (B-0713 stood the play down for exactly this reason). The classifier is a flow-VS-PRICE conviction read - an ALIGNED rally versus a rise on net-sell - so even though tape_conditions serves the flow leg at session and phase grain, the price leg it must be compared against is absent, and a bar on the flow alone would be a different quantity from the one the play tests. audit.argument: D-1 rally QUALITY is claimed to sort next-day magnitude: an ALIGNED rally holds, a CONVICTION-NEGATIVE pop (rise on net-sell or absorption) gives back 50-70% next session, and covering-financed up-legs get credit only to the reversal-reclaim. The founding pair is genuinely well designed and it verifies exactly: 20260630 rose +790 with ph2 sflow -4,266 against pxchg +880, ph_absorb TRUE and absorb_session TRUE, and 20260701 gave back -500 = 63%; 20260624 rose the SAME +790 on aligned phases (+296/+84/-69), absorb_session FALSE, and 20260625 held at -60. Same magnitude, opposite conviction, opposite sequel - that is a controlled comparison and it could have come out otherwise. BUT THE BAND IS ONE DAY'S OUTCOME. '50-70%' is the single realized give-back on 0701 (63%) with a range drawn around it, and I tested it. Over every D-1-up-leg to next-session pair within a group in g17-g23 (g*_mbo_evidence.json joined to actuals), conviction-negative days number 21: the next day closes DOWN 12 times (57%), the median give-back is 21%, and ONLY 2 OF 21 land in the prescribed 50-70% band. Aligned days number 12: next day DOWN 6 times (50%), 1 of 12 in band. I ran two further operationalizations in case mine was too loose - strict absorb_session gives 8/14 (57%) versus 10/19 (53%) with 1 and 2 in band; absorb-or-final-phase-absorb gives 12/20 (60%) versus 6/13 (46%) with 1 and 2 in band. So the DIRECTIONAL half has a weak but consistent lean in the claimed direction across all three definitions (57-60% against 46-53%), and the MAGNITUDE half - which is the play's actual call, it is a magnitude play - is not supported anywhere: the prescribed band captures one or two cases in fourteen to twenty-one. audit.argument: MECHANISM, GENUINELY ARGUED: a void is price discovering where liquidity sits; once found, flow stops moving price, so a numb terminal phase (k3 = |ph3 price change| / |ph3 signed flow| <= 0.05 on >= 500 lots) carries into the next session's NET but not into its RANGE. The record is the most disciplined-LOOKING in the batch - it declares D24 state (a) verbatim, names a base rate, names one counterexample and refuses to explain it away, flags its own boundary instance at 489 lots against a 500 floor, and measures the net-vs-range corollary separately. I REPRODUCED ITS ARITHMETIC EXACTLY off renders/ng_refine_s95/g23_mbo_evidence.json: 0710 k3 = 0.3021, 0713 = 0.0258, 0714 = 0.0177, which is the record's '0.302 -> 0.026 -> 0.018'; 0703's ph3 flow is -489, which is the declared 2% boundary miss. Applying the play's own bar to G20 and G23 reproduces n=6 and 5/6 at <= $200 to the day. THEN THE DEFECT: the same phases data exists for all SEVEN blocks G17-G23 and the search stopped at two. Extending the IDENTICAL test to all 70 scored days gives TWELVE numb seams, of which 5 land at <= $200 - a 42% rate against a 24% base rate, not 5-of-6. And the split is total: the five hits are ALL in G20 and G23, while the six seams in G17, G18 and G19 are 0-FOR-6, with next-day |net| of 380, 420, 1230, 720, 360 and 420 (median 420). The effect is exactly co-extensive with the blocks that were searched. THE RANGE COROLLARY ALSO FAILS TO EXTEND: over all 12 seams the next-day median range is 1,205 against 1,140 for every other day - no compression at all, where the record measured 875 against 1,350. That happens to STRENGTHEN the corollary as worded ('a NET suppressor, NOT a volatility suppressor') while cutting the primary claim from 6.5x to 1.4x (median |net| 370 against 530).

ACROSS THE CORPUS, NO: a search restricted to the two blocks where the mechanism was noticed cannot come out against it. That is the precise thing this audit exists to catch, and it is more dangerous here than in the sloppier plays because the record wears every mark of rigour - a declared D24 state, a named base rate, a kept counterexample, a self-declared boundary weakness. THE HONEST READ IS NOT THAT THE PLAY IS WRONG: 42% against a 24% base rate is still a real lift, and the mechanism is sound. The read is that its stated strength is 5-of-6 when its measured strength at full scope is 5-of-12, and the difference is a block boundary nobody drew on purpose.

The flow axis is served (tape_conditions phase_signed_flow, phase_volume_lots) but the price axis - phase price change, and the impact coefficient k3 = |price change| / |signed flow| that the collapse is measured on - is not served in any state block; k3 is reconstructed from the actual/evidence renders. A bar written on the flow half alone would fire on a different object from the one the play names.

audit.argument: A genuine microstructure mechanism, argued rather than asserted: a phase that prices materially on near-zero net flow is a liquidity VOID - the resting side withdrew rather than size changing hands - so price is DISCOVERING where liquidity actually sits; once found, flow stops moving price and the impact coefficient collapses in both directions. The play is careful about what it claims: 'SEQUENCE claimed; DURATION explicitly NOT claimed', and the reason given is honest (g20's collapse lasted one session, g23's four). ITS ARCHETYPE REPRODUCES TO THE UNIT from g23_mbo_evidence.json: 20260709 phase 2 shows sflow -11, pxchg -1,860, vol 98,400 - the record's 'phase 2 fell -1,860 on -11 net flow across 98,400 lots' exactly. So does C-0715's mirror: 0715 phases 2+3 sum to sflow +6,210 on 68,115 lots for a price change of -80, against the record's '+6,210 net across 68,115 lots for -80'. So do all four post-void pairs: total_sflow +3,747 / +6,326 / +1,089 / +1,333 producing day moves +200 / -60 / -20 / +180. And the g20 second instance is real: 20260529 phase 3 shows sflow -59, pxchg -810, vol 60,930. That is five independent numeric reproductions from a committed evidence file, which is more than most plays in this corpus can offer. WHAT I COULD NOT REPRODUCE, AND IT MATTERS. (1) The k3 triple '0.302 -> 0.026 -> 0.018': the endpoints are recoverable - |day_move| / |total_sflow| gives 0.009 for 0715 (the record's 0.009) and 0.018 for 0716 (the record's 0.018) - but 0.302 does not appear at either the session or the US-phase grain, and the record states no k3 definition. (2) 'the void-signature scan across four groups returns EXACTLY TWO instances'. No signature thresholds are recorded. Running a plainly-stated one (phase |sflow| <= 200, |pxchg| >= 300, vol >= 20,000) over the same four groups returns FIVE: g20 0529 ph3, g21 0615 ph2, g22 0624 ph3, g22 0625 ph2, g23 0709 ph2. The three extra ones are not obviously weaker - g22 0625 ph2 (sflow -12 on 70,526 lots for -380) is a tighter flow void than the g20 instance the record does count. (3) The 'within one session' collapse does not hold for g20 on the session-level k3: 0529 k3 is 0.075, the next session 0601 is 0.261 (the fourth-highest in the block), and the collapse to 0.023 arrives on 0602, two sessions later. It may hold on a signed definition, since 0601 moved -990 against +3,796 of buying, but the record does not say.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: IN PRINCIPLE YES - a corpus-wide scan that returns instances NOT followed by a collapse would refute it, and that is the right shape of test. IN PRACTICE THE SELECTION IS NOT AUDITABLE: with no recorded threshold, 'exactly two instances, both followed by a collapse' cannot be distinguished from a threshold chosen so that the two survivors are the two that worked. My re-scan is the reason this matters - it finds three more candidates, and at least one of them (g22 0625 -> 0626, k3 0.264, mid-range for the block) is not followed by a collapse. Publishing the signature would move this play straight to MECHANISM_VERIFIED or refute it, and either is a good outcome.

audit.argument: THE BEST-EVIDENCED PLAY IN THE BATCH, and it was found the honest way round - discovered on one day and then corpus-searched under D24 rather than asserted. MECHANISM, and it is a real one that makes a distinct prediction: the pre-print run is INVENTORY not conviction, built by desks positioning for the number; the print is the scheduled moment that inventory must be defended; a counter impulse means the people who built it are liquidating, which is why the round-trip OVERSHOOTS rather than stopping at flat. THE SYMMETRIC ARM IS REFUSED: on the five Thursdays entering 10:29 with a run of -300 or worse, no 60-second impulse reached |300| at all, so the rule declines to apply and says so. AND THE DEFLATIONARY READING IS NAMED BY THE AUTHOR: 'that this is ordinary first-minute momentum is not excluded by n=6', with 0604 offered as the case that would distinguish it (a mild -110 counter failed to stop a +1130 day, which a momentum rule would have faded). The 6/6 sort could have been 3/6; the 300-second horizon DID come out the other way and is recorded; the down-run population could have shown the same sort and did not, so the rule was scoped rather than extended. The unverifiable part, declared: the 60-second impulse values themselves are not in the committed corpus - g23_mbo_evidence.json carries only three phases per day - so I can confirm every outcome and the 10:29:06 high but not the impulses. The +-300 bar also sits in a wide empty gap (-110 to -420), so its exact value is unconstrained by the data.

legacy_notes.falsifier: a block where burn licenses a directional lean that delivers, with the balance term pointing the other way
legacy_notes.conditions_note: IT IS A PROHIBITION, NOT A THRESHOLD - the play's own health note says so. 'Burn may CONFIRM demand arrival and may DAMP a lean that contradicts it; it may NEVER license a directional lean of its own, and must never act as a SUPPRESSOR before magnitude is derived' places no bar on any quantity; it restricts what a reading may be used FOR. Its two named inputs are served and both move freely (est_gas_burn_bcfd 21.9-51.0 and storage.vs_5yr 86-162 across the modern blocks), but the play attaches no cut to either, and the balance term it requires is under-specified at exactly the point where a bar would sit: the audit found the cited quantity has TWO counter-signed limbs (vs_5yr widening 151->162 reads bearish while injections collapsing 87->61->41 reads tightening) with no rule for which carries the sign. Writing a threshold here would manufacture the specification the play is missing.

audit.argument: Claim: burn confirms that weather-driven demand ARRIVED; it does not price it, because burn is a numerator with no balance-clearing denominator. Therefore burn may confirm, may DAMP a lean that contradicts it, but may NEVER license a directional lean of its own and must never act as a SUPPRESSOR before magnitude is derived. This is a PROHIBITION, and it was born out of the hardest event in the corpus: the retirement of its own predecessor, weather.burn_conversion_gate, on that gate's named forward test, by four specialists including its author. The mechanism is causal and checkable (a rate with no stock term cannot say whether the arriving demand clears the surplus), and it was tested with numbers that came out badly and were published anyway - D-0716 reports the balance term as 2/3 as a gate revocation and 4/7 as a standalone direction sorter and explicitly declines to claim it as one; E offers its own reformulation as 'a MEASUREMENT TO RUN, not a play to fire (n=1 clean)'; the forward field opens with the words 'HONEST AND THIN'. That is the conduct this audit exists to reward.
audit.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: YES, decisively, and it did - this play exists BECAUSE the previous version's written falsifier discharged against it. The predecessor's falsifier was 'a burn-confirmed CDD add that fails to deliver, in G23+'; C-0708 found three clean up-fires in G23 delivering 0 of 3, and D-0709 found the CDD-add limb was a CONSTANT (positive 20/20 days across two groups) - a limb that never changes sign cannot gate. The successor's own numbers (2/3, 4/7) were then reported unflatteringly rather than rounded up.

NEVER fade the crowded side during its squeeze. Limits: weekly cadence, Tuesday-positions-Friday-publication, and the futures book and options-implied book can sit at OPPOSITE extremes (G11 open: 2.83rd vs 97.17th pctile) - read BOTH.
